rules.title: Exception in use without a recorded approval
rules.fix: Stop relying on the exception until an authorized approver signs it, or close it and apply the policy.

rules.title: Expired exception still in use
rules.fix: Close the exception and apply the policy, or re-assess the risk and get a new approval with a new expiry date.

rules.title: Exception has no expiry date
rules.fix: Set an expiry date within the maximum allowed for this risk level so the exception is reviewed again.

rules.title: Approved for longer than policy allows
rules.fix: Shorten the expiry date to the maximum allowed for this risk level, or document why a longer period was approved.

rules.title: Approver lacks authority for this risk level
rules.fix: Have the exception approved by someone authorized to accept this level of risk.

rules.title: Exception approved by the person who requested it
rules.fix: Have an independent, authorized person review and approve the exception.

rules.title: No current risk owner
rules.fix: Assign a current employee as risk owner and have them confirm they accept the risk.

rules.title: Approver has left the organization
rules.fix: Have a current authorized approver re-confirm the exception.

rules.title: No compensating control for a high or critical risk
rules.fix: Put a compensating control in place (for example extra monitoring or network isolation) and record it.

rules.title: Compensating control not verified recently
rules.fix: Test that the compensating control is working and record the date and evidence.

rules.title: No remediation plan, or remediation date passed
rules.fix: Record a plan and a realistic date to remove the need for the exception, and track it to completion.

rules.title: Exception renewed too many times
rules.fix: Treat the exception as a permanent risk: escalate it, fund the fix, or formally update the policy.

rules.title: Exception expires soon
rules.fix: Decide now whether to close, fix, or renew the exception, so it does not lapse while still in use.
